items.claim: Saving from trial A while trial B is focused
items.note: The panel now gives each trial its own instance, so an unfinished save clears the saved edits from A and leaves B's edits and Save button alone. The filter and tab stay put when you switch trials.

items.claim: An edit made while a save is in flight was thrown away when the save finished
items.note: The save now drops only overrides still holding the value it saved, and scale edits equal to the one it saved.

items.claim: A scale edit outlived its steps' overrides and was later shown and saved
items.note: Every commit and reset now drops a scale edit once none of its steps is overridden.

items.claim: Jumping and reading found the panel through two different lookups
A picked section stayed lit after scrolling with the scrollbar , or after `scrollIntoView` from a token link (B)
items.note: The hold now ends once the list moves from where the jump left it.

items.claim: History opened once per trial, so another tab's steps were overwritten and later reverted by undo
items.note: The history is opened again from the store whenever another view writes it.

items.claim: Commits in one tick were not one step when `history.coalesceMs` is 0
